findings.title: Odyssey transports a retained household, not a fresh colony
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Gravship captures actual pawns/things and spatial context, carries serialized story history and restores them into a destination map. GenerateGravship despawns original objects; placement respawns them. This supports identity continuity without rerolling an arrival body.

findings.title: Layer laws change routes and incident admission
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Surface and Orbit are concrete PlanetLayerDef records; an abstract orbit base is the third raw row. Orbit disallows caravans, requires incident/arrival/game-condition whitelists and changes range scaling. IncidentWorker consumes the layer allow/deny rules; VacuumUtility reads biome vacuum plus pawn protection. These are different places under one game, not demonstrated metaphysical multiverses.

findings.title: Keeping the departure map is conditional
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: TakeoffEnded abandons a map without a grav anchor; the anchored branch updates bill destinations. AbandonMap processes left-behind pawns. TickManager.DoSingleTick iterates loaded maps and advances one shared world clock. Multiple active maps do not imply frozen independent branches or automatic preservation of every departure.

findings.title: Inheritance reads germline, expression reads active genes
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Pawn_GeneTracker stores endogenes and xenogenes separately; pregnancy samples Endogenes, with 0.5 single-parent and 1.0 shared-gene base chances, prerequisite removal and up to 50 metabolic-range attempts. Gene.Active can be false through override, age or mutation state. Owning a gene is distinct from expressing or transmitting it.

findings.title: Learning quality broadens childhood choices
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Need_Learning feeds growth points through Pawn_AgeTracker; GrowthUtility defines nine tiers and growth birthdays 7/10/13. Tier changes trait/passion choices and gains. A pending growth letter suspends further point gain until resolution. Learning desires, lesson availability and observing actual adult work are separate readers.

findings.title: Ideology is a bundle read by several systems
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: MemeDef constrains precepts and rituals; Ideo caches derived needs, roles, thoughts and buildables. StatWorker directly reads precept offsets/factors and role effects. Role work restrictions and temporary abilities have assignment/unassignment notifications. One belief therefore changes several verbs rather than only a faction score.

findings.title: Rituals have admission, participation, outcome and memory
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Precept_Ritual distinguishes anytime/date/event obligations and repeat penalties. Behavior checks start eligibility. Quality-based outcome workers weight eligible outcomes, apply extra effects and source-attributed memories, and send a report. This is not one prayer button with a fixed reward.

findings.title: Anomaly keeps subject progress, notes and research distinct
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: CompStudiable owns subject progress and study cooldown/interactions. CompStudyUnlocks keeps resolved thresholds, next note index and retained letters. StudyManager routes knowledge to ResearchManager category projects; overflow follows an authored category link. A generic creature codex count is not the whole unlock path.

findings.title: Containment changes study yield and escape timing
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: CurrentlyStudiable checks subject state, enabled flag, frequency and applicable platform/prison rules. Containment mode must permit study. ContainmentUtility compares holding strength with required strength and uses separate curves for study yield and escape interval; cold, movement and captivity duration can change escape intervals.

findings.title: Bills express inventory goals with hysteresis
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Bill_Production supports repeat count, forever and target count. Target mode counts qualifying stock, can pause at target and resume at a lower threshold. Product counting is scoped by map/storage/filter/equipment settings. ShouldDoNow can mutate paused state, so it is not a pure projection API.

findings.title: Blocker feedback is contextual and incomplete
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: WorkGiver_DoBill checks usability/reservation, skill, worker/bill restrictions and ingredients. Missing-material details are gathered for the forced menu path; ordinary AI can defer a failed search by 500-600 ticks. Several early exits have no specific reason. A null job is not a durable human explanation.

findings.title: Production separates recipe, actual ingredients and completion
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: GenRecipe has ordinary products and special butchery/smelting handlers. Meal ingredients use nutrition values; drug recipes can be generated from ThingDef recipeMaker/costList instead of standalone RecipeDef rows. Toils_Recipe creates products, consumes ingredients and notifies bill completion before placing/hauling results. This mutable donor flow is not a YAIRPG atomic-save contract.

findings.title: Storyteller stages have distinct failure semantics
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: Storyteller ticks incident queue and samples components each 1000 ticks. RandomMain samples mean-time timing and weighted categories; OnOffCycle uses a seeded interval calendar. Eligibility and weights are separate. TryFire rechecks eligibility and records history only after TryExecute succeeds.

findings.title: Population intent is a soft selection pressure
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: AdjustedPopulation weights babies, children, prisoners and slaves differently, includes borrowed colonists, and has a quest-aware variant. Population intent reads the storyteller curve and applies adaptation only to positive intent. Final incident weight also includes current-population curve, incident factors and recent repetition penalties. This is not a fixed colony cap.

findings.title: Threat budget and population recruitment pressure differ
findings.scope: static decompiled 1.7.4979 and installed raw XML; no runtime
findings.summary: DefaultThreatPointsNow combines target wealth, eligible pawn contributions, health/age adjustments, random range, adaptation, difficulty and days passed. This differs from population intent and per-incident weight. A carrier with retained story state can preserve pacing history across moves without implying every destination has the same threats.
